title: Functional and Existential AI Dependence in Dental Students and Professionals: A Hybrid Network Analysis
why_it_matters: INTRODUCTION: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools are now embedded in dental teaching and clinical learning, yet little is known about how reliance on them is psychologically organised in dental students and professionals. This study mapped how two forms of AI dependence relate to problematic social media use, anxiety, and attentional control. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Cross-sectional online survey of 342 Brazilian dental students and professionals. Latent factor scores from confirmatory factor analysis were combined with observed variables in a hybrid network. Network structure, centrality, and stability were estimated with regularised Gaussian graphical modelling and bootstrapping.
